name: מָכִיר
summary: Machir is borne by a man of the United Monarchy and by Machir son of Manasseh, ancestor of a branch of that tribe. The name is written with the מכר spelling but scripture does not state its meaning.
note: TIPNR records two people under Machir, with the Manasseh record also carrying the gentilic מָכִירִי.
